definitions.gloss: the masses, general public, common people
definitions.explanation: Ordinary people as a whole, especially in contrast to the elite or privileged classes.

examples.japanese: {大衆|たいしゅう}⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まった→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大衆|たいしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This movie is popular with the masses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大衆|たいしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}よう→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The politician is trying to gain public support.

notes:
{大衆|たいしゅう} refers to ordinary people as a collective group.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大衆|たいしゅう}⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: popular culture
- {大衆|たいしゅう}⟦{娯楽|ごらく}→娯楽：00074_goraku⟧: popular entertainment
- {大衆|たいしゅう}⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧: inexpensive restaurant for the masses
- {大衆|たいしゅう}{向|む}け: aimed at the general public
